description: Generate variations of an existing brand name using deterministic prefix, suffix, compound, and wordplay patterns. Returns JSON alternatives[] each with the name, the pattern used, a description, and a 0-100 brandability score. Use this to riff on a name the user already has; use namesniper_generate for brand-new AI ideas from a description. Free, no API key needed.

count.description: Number of alternatives to generate (1-20, default: 8)

name: namesniper_alternatives
